description: 한국도로공사_1종시설물 (터널) [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국도로공사. 본 데이터는 한국도로공사가 관리하는 1종시설물 중 터널에 대한 정보를 포함하고 있다. 고속도로에 설치된 주요 터널의 본부,지사,노선,방향,터널명,개통년도의 항목으로 구성된다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국도로공사. Its tags are 건축법, 유지관리, 구조물, 구조물정보, 고속도로. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-08-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
